stories.title: Femi Kuti and the enduring spirit of Felabration
stories.excerpt: Following Felabration?s closing concert in Lagos, our artist spotlight looks at Femi Kuti?s place in a celebration connecting Afrobeat?s past and present.
paragraphs: Femi Kuti was among the performers listed for the closing concert of Felabration 2026 at the New Afrika Shrine in Lagos, according to TVC News. The festival ended on Sunday, 18 October, after a week celebrating Fela Anikulapo-Kuti?s musical legacy.

TVC?s report also named Sean Tizzle among the closing-night performers. Its account of the previous evening included Daddy Showkey, Peruzzi, L.A.X and Barry Jhay, bringing musicians with different styles into the same festival programme.

For this edition of Aduke?s artist spotlight, that connection between generations is the focus. Femi?s appearance places a member of the Kuti family alongside performers from Nigeria?s contemporary scene, within a festival built around Fela?s influence.
This is a sourced festival brief, not an eyewitness review. The accompanying portrait is an archive photograph from 2013 and does not show the 2026 concert.

sources.label: TVC News ? festival closing report, 19 October 2026

stories.title: AFRIFF names international jury ahead of its November return to Lagos
stories.excerpt: The festival?s fifteenth edition runs from 1?7 November, with Keith Shiri coordinating a jury drawn from filmmaking, criticism and production.
paragraphs: The Africa International Film Festival has announced its international jury for the 2026 edition in Lagos. In its 9 October announcement, the festival confirmed that the event will run from 1 to 7 November.

Keith Shiri joins as Festival Programmer and Jury Coordinator. The ten-member group also includes Blessing Uzzi, Jerry Chiemeke, Jean-Pierre Bekolo and Femi Elufowoju Jr., alongside professionals working across cinema, documentary and cultural production.

The festival?s theme, Frames of the Future: Africa?s Creative Intelligence, places attention on how African stories are created and reach audiences. Its visitor announcement describes events across Victoria Island and Lekki, with the opening gala on 1 November and the Globe Awards on 7 November.

Film lovers planning to attend should use the festival?s own schedule and ticket pages for the latest screening and access information. Jury membership is an announcement about the selection process, not a declaration of this year?s winners.

sources.label: AFRIFF ? festival dates and visitor programme

stories.title: ACCES brings African music careers and live showcases to Johannesburg
stories.excerpt: The 28?31 October gathering combines industry conversations with live music, with free conference registration and separately ticketed evening events.
paragraphs: Johannesburg is preparing to host ACCES from 28 to 31 October 2026. The Music In Africa Foundation?s programme announcement puts the conference sessions on 29 and 30 October at The Forum, The Campus, in Bryanston.

The organiser expects more than 700 delegates from over 45 countries. Sessions will examine international careers, music investment, rights income, touring and digital innovation, alongside workshops and opportunities to meet other professionals.

Live showcases form a separate part of the event through ACCES Industry Nights. Artists named in the programme include Sun-El Musician, Blick Bassy and The Joy, with performances spread across Johannesburg venues.

Conference attendance requires registration but is free; evening performances require their own tickets. Artists and music-business readers should check the official programme for venue details and availability rather than assume one pass covers every event.

stories.title: Bien opens a new chapter with Quality Control ahead of Alusa Continua
stories.excerpt: The Kenyan singer?s new label partnership accompanies ?I?ll Be Okay?, while Apple Music lists his next album for 20 November.
paragraphs: Kenyan singer Bien has entered a partnership involving Quality Control and Courtesy Of, according to music-industry publication HITS. Its 9 October report connects the announcement with the release of his single I?ll Be Okay.

The report describes the move as an expansion into Africa for Quality Control. For Bien, who became known as a member of Sauti Sol before pursuing solo work, it marks a new stage in the distribution and promotion of his music.
Apple Music?s pre-release listing independently gives 20 November 2026 as the date for Alusa Continua. The listing credits Courtesy Of and Quality Control Music.

The album has not been reviewed here: the release date is still ahead of this report. Readers can follow the official listing for changes and use the new single as an introduction to this chapter of Bien?s solo career.

sources.label: Apple Music ? Alusa Continua pre-release listing

stories.title: Music Business Awards Africa sets 21 November ceremony
stories.excerpt: The awards look beyond the stage to recognise managers, publishers, labels and other professionals working across Africa?s music economy.
paragraphs: The Music Business Awards Africa website lists 21 November 2026 for this year?s ceremony and says the nomination window has closed.

The published categories span individual professionals and organisations. They include artist management, songwriting, independent labels, publishing, live events and music education, giving attention to work that audiences may not see on stage.
There are also artist-focused categories, including independent breakthrough and audience recognition. The organiser separates these from company and special-merit categories.

This is a calendar update based on the organiser?s published information, not a winners list. Readers following a particular nominee should consult the official awards pages for confirmed announcements and any updates to the event.

sources.label: Music Business Awards Africa ? official categories and ceremony date

stories.title: Netflix?s October lineup brings new dramas, thrillers and returning series
stories.excerpt: The streamer?s published October guide highlights East of Eden, Animals and returning series including Lupin and The Diplomat.
paragraphs: Netflix?s October 2026 guide offers a mix of new films and returning series. Published by the streamer?s Tudum editorial team, the list includes East of Eden, Animals and Sacrifice, alongside more episodes of Lupin, Nobody Wants This and The Diplomat.

The guide describes East of Eden as an adaptation by Zoe Kazan, with Florence Pugh among its cast. Animals features Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington in a thriller about a family confronted with a kidnapping.

For readers choosing between a film and a series, the selection offers several different formats rather than one clear recommendation. This brief summarises the announced lineup; it is not a review or a claim that every listed title is already available.

The source is a US-facing Netflix guide. Nigerian viewers should check the title pages in their own account, as availability and release timing can vary by territory. The cover is an archive photograph of a Netflix stand in 2019, not a still from these titles.

sources.label: Netflix Tudum ? October 2026 guide, published 30 September
